title: Implement FT-003 first-Boss bootstrap and admin identity service
verify: First-Boss command uses the existing Foundation settings/database path and refuses to run before canonical Farm bootstrap or after an active Boss exists.
First-Boss password is read only through getpass, never argv/env/stdin echo, and command output/evidence redacts password material.
First-Boss success atomically creates active Account, active boss FarmMembership, and exactly one account_created system-bootstrap AdminAuditRecord without creating a session.
Boss admin service atomically creates local Accounts and active FarmMembership rows with Argon2id password hashes and exactly one account_created account-attributed AdminAuditRecord.

Admin service implements Account disable, membership role change, last-active-Boss protection, safe personnel list, Plant projection source reads, audit list, and duplicate-login versus generic persistence failure classification.
Failed validation, authorization, duplicate login, existing active Boss, password mismatch, and injected persistence failures roll back without partial Account, Membership, or audit records.
FT-003-BHV-001 and FT-003-BHV-002 are covered by executable evidence.
evidence_required: admin service transaction and rollback test output
constraints: Use the existing Access & Admin metadata, Foundation DB/session/Alembic path, and session-security primitives; do not create a second identity subsystem.
The first-Boss password must be read through getpass only and must never appear in argv, environment variables, logs, audit, evidence, or response bodies.
Do not create Farm, tomato_001, Plant lifecycle/access semantics, PWA UI, or sessions in the first-Boss command.
Every successful admin mutation represented by the AdminAuditRecord taxonomy writes exactly one same-transaction audit record; failed and no-op commands write none.
A duplicate normalized login may be reported as ADMIN_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT only when positively classified; unrelated persistence failures remain generic and redacted.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model owns Account, FarmMembership, and AdminAuditRecord authority.
Last active Boss cannot be disabled or demoted.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, audit, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, agent context, or evidence.
verification_targets: Inspect first-Boss command implementation for getpass-only password entry and no argv/env password path.
Inject persistence failures and prove rollback leaves no partial Account, FarmMembership, or AdminAuditRecord.
purpose: Create the secure local first-Boss bootstrap and reusable Boss admin identity/audit service before HTTP exposure.
success_outcome: The local system can create the first Boss once and can perform Boss-admin identity mutations with atomic Account/Membership/audit writes, last-Boss protection, Argon2id password hashing, and redacted failures.
anti_goals: No password reset, email recovery, OAuth, SaaS tenancy, or multi-Farm support.

forbidden_scope: password reset or hosted identity flows
stop_conditions: TASK-015-T3-FT-002-W4 is not done or its Farm/AdminAudit assumptions are contradicted.
The canonical Farm is missing and the command would need to create it instead of routing to FT-002 bootstrap.
The implementation cannot prove getpass-only password input for first-Boss bootstrap.
Atomic Account/Membership/audit writes cannot be proven under rollback.
Last-active-Boss protection cannot be enforced without a new product decision.
Diagnostics or evidence contain password, password_hash, session token, token hash, auth header, cookie, DSN credential, or raw SQL exception text.
